policyText.privacyPolicy: At Smart Kitchen Store, customer privacy is paramount. We only collect details necessary for processing your order and fulfilling delivery within Nigeria.
policyText.termsAndConditions: All orders placed are confirmed via call or WhatsApp before dispatch. Payment on delivery is available in eligible zones upon package inspection.
policyText.returnsPolicy: 7-day inspection and exchange period upon delivery. Items must remain unused in original protective packaging. Includes 1-Year Manufacturer Warranty.

faqText.question: 1. What is the Smart Kitchen Piano Sink (75 × 45 cm)?
faqText.answer: It is a premium multifunctional culinary workstation featuring 4 tactile piano keys for water modes, flying rain waterfall spout, high-pressure glass rinser, internal hydroelectric LED temperature screen, and sliding cutting board ledges.

faqText.question: 2. How does the digital temperature display work without batteries?
faqText.answer: The LED display and ambient glow are powered 100% by internal hydroelectric water hydraulics. As water flows through the faucet, it generates power automatically. Zero batteries, wiring, or electrical connections required.

faqText.question: 3. What dimensions and countertop cutout are required?
faqText.answer: The sink measures 750 mm × 450 mm (75 × 45 cm) with a generous 205 mm deep basin. It fits standard Nigerian 700 × 400 mm countertop cutouts and supports topmount (drop-in), undermount, or flushmount installation.

faqText.question: 4. What is included in the complete box package?
faqText.answer: Every package contains the SUS304 Nano Piano Sink basin, Integrated Waterfall Faucet Tower with 360° pull-out sprayer, Solid Wood Chopping Board, Stainless Steel Perforated Washing Colander, Triangular Prep Basin, Automatic Glass Rinser, Soap Dispenser, and heavy-duty anti-odor drainage pipe assembly with standard 1/2" flexible hoses.

faqText.question: 5. How does delivery work across Nigeria?
faqText.answer: We deliver nationwide across all 36 states and the FCT. For Lagos State, doorstep delivery is ₦5,000 and takes 1–2 business days. For other states, delivery takes 3–5 business days to your major commercial park terminal or direct doorstep.

faqText.question: 6. Which payment methods are available?
faqText.answer: We support Payment on Delivery (Cash or Bank Transfer upon inspecting the sink) across major cities in Nigeria.

faqText.question: 7. How do I contact customer support or confirm via WhatsApp?
faqText.answer: Once you submit your order form, you can immediately confirm with your unique order reference directly on WhatsApp with one click, or call our desk at 09136827730.

reviews.name: Arc. Emeka Okafor
reviews.comment: Installed this in our newly remodeled kitchen in Lekki. The waterfall faucet and the piano switch keys feel like a million bucks. Water pressure from the glass rinser is fantastic and the nano finish cleans easily.

reviews.name: Hajiya Aisha Mohammed
reviews.comment: Delivered promptly to Abuja within 3 days. Our plumber had zero issues with the standard fittings. The digital temperature display helps so much when preparing hot water for baby bottles and rinsing oily pots.

reviews.name: Engr. Tunde Adeleke
reviews.comment: Very thick and solid 304 stainless steel. The wooden cutting board and colander fit right onto the inner tracks, turning the sink into a full prep station. Worth every kobo of the ₦135,000.

reviews.name: Dr. (Mrs) Nkechi Wilcox
reviews.comment: Ordered 2 units for our duplex in Port Harcourt. Excellent communication from the Moonlight Crescent team and the piano keys have such a smooth, high-grade mechanical feel.
